SELECT lv2.epp2_desc, lv2.epp2_reference_1, lv2.epp2_ref_date_1, lv2.epp2_ref_date_2, mrt.pmrt_desc, dtp.pdst_desc, lv2.epp2_active,
  lv2.epp2_reference_2,lv2.pslh_saleshier_code,lv2.epp2_reference_3,lv2.epp2_ref_val_2,lv2.epp2_ref_val_10
    FROM snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 lv2
    INNER JOIN snd_pr_dst_dsrtype dtp ON lv2.porg_orgacode = dtp.porg_orgacode AND lv2.pdst_dsr_type = dtp.pdst_dsr_type
    INNER JOIN glb_pr_mrt_maritalstatus mrt ON lv2.porg_orgacode = mrt.porg_orgacode AND lv2.pmrt_maritalstatus = mrt.pmrt_maritalstatus
    WHERE lv2.epp2_reference_2 IS NOT NULL
    AND lv2.epp2_reference_2 <> ''
    AND lv2.epp2_active <> 'A'
    AND lv2.epp2_ref_date_1 IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  (select lpad(cast(max(cast(Pdst_dsr_type   as integer)+1) as varchar),4,'0') from snd_pr_dst_dsrtype where porg_orgacode='010104') as Pdst_dsr_type, 
  pdst_desc , pdst_abrv ,case when pdst_auto_create_user = 'Y' then 'Yes' else 'No'end pdst_auto_create_user,
  case when pdst_allow_mob_login = 'Y' then 'Yes' else 'No' end  pdst_allow_mob_login , pdst_nature_identifier ,
  case when pdst_default ='Y' then 'Yes' else 'No' end pdst_default ,
  case when pdst_active ='Y' then 'Yes' else 'No'
  end pdst_active  
FROM snd_pr_dst_dsrtype d inner join glb_pr_idn_identifiertype n on
d.porg_orgacode  = n.porg_orgacode  
where d.porg_orgacode='010104'
LIMIT 1;

  (select lpad(cast(max(cast(pdvt_devicetype   as integer)+1) as varchar),4,'0') from glb_pr_dvt_devicetype where porg_orgacode='010104') as pdvt_dvt_devicetype,

SELECT 
  (select lpad(cast(max(cast(pprt_price_type  as integer)+1) as varchar),4,'0') from   snd_pr_prt_pricetype where porg_orgacode='010104' and length(pprt_price_type)>=4) as pprt_price_type,
 pprt_desc  , pprt_abrv  , case when pprt_default  ='Y' then 'Yes' else 'No' end pprt_default  , case when pprt_active  ='Y' then 'Yes' else 'No' 
  end pprt_active  
FROM snd_pr_prt_pricetype
 where porg_orgacode='010104'
 LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  (
    SELECT 
      CASE 
        WHEN MAX(CAST(padt_address_type AS integer)) IS NOT NULL THEN
          LPAD(CAST(MAX(CAST(padt_address_type AS integer)) + 1 AS varchar), 4, '0') 
        ELSE '0001' -- Default value if there are no valid integers in padt_address_type
      END
    FROM  (
      SELECT padt_address_type
      FROM glb_pr_adt_addresstype 
      WHERE porg_orgacode = '010104' 
        AND padt_address_type ~ '^[0-9]+$' -- Only select rows where padt_address_type contains numeric values
        AND length(padt_address_type) >= 4
    ) AS subquery
  ) AS padt_address_type,
  padt_desc, padt_abrv,
  CASE WHEN padt_default = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS padt_default,
  CASE WHEN padt_active = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS padt_active
FROM glb_pr_adt_addresstype
WHERE porg_orgacode = '010104'
LIMIT 1;
